# Screenshots

Drop platform-specific install / demo screenshots here.

## Naming convention

```
win-01-install-ps1.png          # Windows install.ps1 output
win-02-ribbon-tab.png           # Ribbon tab in PowerPoint for Windows
win-03-generate-demo.png        # After clicking Generate Demo button
mac-pptm-01-installer.png       # Mac .pptm path — installer output
mac-pptm-02-vba-editor.png      # Option+F11 VBA editor with module imported
mac-ppam-01-addins-dialog.png   # Mac .ppam path — Tools → Add-ins dialog
```

## Why this folder is empty right now

Screenshots need a real Windows + Mac PowerPoint environment to capture.
This is a **post-1.0 task** for the maintainer; until then, the textual
smoke checklist in `../QUICK-TEST.md` is the source of truth.

When adding screenshots, keep each PNG under 300 KB (`pngquant` or
`optipng -o7`), and link them from `../README.md`.
